rules: PRODUCTION_SPEC §12–§18; flat LIGHT backgrounds; Casio images are cut-outs/photos — cut out (rembg) where background isn't flat light. Whole real product; 1–3 words; 2-D objects next to the product; watermark below content; logo v5 end card; audio LOCKED (narrate.py + mix.sh). Length 50–58 s. No Casio logo drawn; no real banknotes.
official_clips: none — casio.com blocked for automation; no promo video use
palette_for_this_video: paper #FAF8F5 main; lavender #ECE8FB display beats; sky for specs; blush #FBE7E2 THE CATCH; mint reveal; ember accent for prices
new_objects: none expected — reuse priceTag, bars, slider, calipers, scale, battery, calendar, globe/worldMap, waterDrop, crossMark, gauge/dialScale, questionStamp, clockRing (render/kit/OBJECTS.md); if a swimmer icon is needed, add it to the library

scenes.anchor: Casio's new watch costs almost seventy percent more in the US.
scenes.image: A black LF-40W cut out, centred 62% width
scenes.object: two priceTags either side: left 'US $42.95' (ember), right 'JAPAN ¥4,400' (muted); a counter 0→70% pops above

scenes.anchor: Meet the Casio L F forty W.
scenes.object: globe/worldMap mini: pin drops on USA; generic store card (ui appTile 'US STORE') slides in

scenes.anchor: Forty-two ninety-five, in black, blue or beige.
scenes.image: A, B, C side by side (each 30% width), slide in left→right staggered
scenes.object: priceTag '$42.95' swings under the middle watch

scenes.anchor: Now look at the face. Three rows of bars, like a tiny music mixer!
scenes.image: D display close-up, centred 80%, slow push-in
scenes.object: bars: 3 rows of generic slider/equalizer bars drawn beside the watch, animating

scenes.anchor: Here's the wild part. Those bars count your seconds. Tens in the middle, ones at the bottom.
scenes.image: D crop on the lower two bar rows, 85%
scenes.object: bars: middle row fills in 10-s steps, bottom row in 1-s steps, labels '10s' and '1s'; clockRing ticking

scenes.anchor: It's eight point six millimeters thin.
scenes.image: A rotated side-on is not available → use A small (40%) with calipers object
scenes.object: calipers close on a side-profile silhouette of the case reading '8.6 mm'
scale: watch drops on a kitchen scale, display counts to '23 g'
counter '5' with bell icon, five bells pop in a row

scenes.anchor: and about three years of battery.
scenes.object: battery object fills; calendar flips '3 YEARS'

scenes.anchor: Here's the catch. In Japan, you'd pay forty-four hundred yen.
scenes.object: worldMap/globe pans to Japan; priceTag '¥4,400' drops

scenes.anchor: That's about twenty-five dollars, before tax.
scenes.object: two priceTags side by side: '$42.95 US' vs '≈$25 JP (pre-tax)'; slash through the gap; gauge needle to '+70%'
waterDrop splashes bounce off; crossMark over a generic swimmer icon

scenes.anchor: By our score? Sixty-four out of a hundred. Spec!
scenes.object: dialScale/gauge sweeps to 64; k snaps upright (SPEC)

scenes.anchor: If you want a fun, cheap watch.
scenes.object: pill ✓ FUN & CHEAP pops; small ✗ SWIM pill fades in under it

scenes.anchor: Be honest. Would you pay forty-three dollars for this?
scenes.object: priceTag '$42.95' and '¥4,400' back as in frame 1; questionStamp '?'
